scope: Closer positive precedent search for current parent-reconciled C01/C03/C05; no rule revision or independent design validation
combined_count_scope: Initial current-study 22 games/23 sources plus these 3 distinct games/3 sources. Historical seventeen-game map is excluded from this count.

sources.source_type: Official game manual distributed through the Steam app manual link
sources.read_depth: Direct PDF text: Orders by Courier at Command Level, PDF pages 42–43; Couriers/Send Courier Message, PDF pages 68–73 (zero-based indexes). Targeted sections, not full manual audit.
sources.supports: Courier delivery causes command delay; messages specify recipient and execution time, and can contain composed orders.
sources.limits: Inspected text does not establish interception, courier death, or player amendment of a hostile carried message. No game was played.
sources.evidence_anchor: PDF text lines 950–972 and 1553–1674; page indexes 42/43 and 68–73
sources.publication_date: Not inferred from search engine crawl date; legacy Waterloo manual.

sources.read_depth: Direct description, Master Advanced Command and Control section
sources.supports: General positioning and commitment are tied to issuing orders, sending couriers, morale support and direct combat.
sources.limits: Description does not specify physical delivery failure, interception or hostile message amendment; early-access advertised design, not exhaustive implementation proof.

sources.source_type: Official Dynamic Pixels/tinyBuild game site About and FAQ
sources.read_depth: Direct About paragraph and How does A.I. work FAQ
sources.supports: The official description promises countermeasures to repeated routes, including traps and cameras.
sources.limits: No algorithm, exact memory length, event scheduling or current-version runtime behavior is established. The page also contains historical alpha material; do not infer machine-learning implementation.

access_notes: All adopted technical evidence is primary: official manual, publisher/developer description or official game site.
Player forum and third-party wiki results were discovery leads only and did not establish courier interception or runtime AI behavior.
No new C05 game feature was adopted; its current fee/entitlement contract is compared against existing positive precedents and a written conventional substitute.
Source search is finite and targeted; failed literal text matches are not evidence that a game lacks the queried mechanic.
